name: JoAi: Get Loyalty Program

description.en: Load the team's loyalty program with settings, rewards, tiers and all collect points (QR codes, Advent doors, checkpoints). Collect points show whether a code is required, never the code itself. Today's code of daily-rotating points is shown only to signed-in team members (loyalty editor, checkpoint display).
description.de: Lädt das Treueprogramm des Teams mit Einstellungen, Prämien, Stufen und allen Sammelpunkten (QR-Codes, Advent-Türchen, Checkpoints). Sammelpunkte zeigen nur, ob ein Code nötig ist, nie den Code selbst. Den heutigen Code täglich wechselnder Punkte sehen nur angemeldete Team-Mitglieder (Loyalty-Editor, Checkpoint-Display).

bot: Use this before changing collect points: joai-loyalty-collect-points-set replaces the whole list, so start from the collect points returned here and keep every entry that should stay (with its codeRotation). Codes are never returned here; if someone asks for today's code, point them to a team member with the loyalty editor or the checkpoint display.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
